Name: Kitsutsune's Dodos for BFAV
Author: Ciriun
Description:
Introducing Kitsutsune's Dodos converted to work with BFAV! Not balanced or anything and they sound like chickens, but they might have some fun surprises in store!

Original version by Kitsutsune can be found here: https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/swans-and-dodos-and-aptonoth.111758/

**Update 5/4/2020**
To celebrate finally getting my BFAV mods working (and also my birthday!) I'm having a Birthday Blue Birds Bash! This means there is an alternative version that has blue dodos. Those familiar with Animal Crossing might find them familiar and for those who aren't they're still cute and totally optional. Just be sure to only use on version!

Manifest.Name: BFAV Dodos
Manifest.Description: Adds Dodos that don't replace chickens
Manifest.Author: Ciriun and Kitsutsune
